build_upsample2d_layer: build a PyTorch module that upsamples a 2D tensor using nearest neighbor interpolation then applies a 3x3 convolution
build_downsample2d_layer: build a PyTorch module that downsamples a 2D tensor using zero padding and a strided 3x3 convolution
test_upsample2d_forward: test the Upsample2D forward pass by passing a 4D tensor and verifying output shape is doubled in height and width
test_downsample2d_asymmetric_padding: test the Downsample2D forward pass with asymmetric padding enabled and verify output spatial dimensions are halved
review_upsample2d_and_downsample2d: review the Upsample2D and Downsample2D classes for correct channel preservation and spatial dimension changes
